angles.title: Days I walk

uses.quote: something about routines, but I don't know what I would say about routines that people haven't already said a hundred times
Maybe it's about how I feel different on days I walk.

open_questions: How do you feel different on days you walk? The memo says you do, not how.
What would you say about routines that hasn't been said a hundred times? That is the piece's claim, and it isn't in the memo yet.

angles.title: It felt like it mattered

uses.quote: I had a feeling about something, like a mood more than an idea.
But it felt like it mattered while I was walking, and I can't say why.

open_questions: Is the subject the feeling itself, or the habit of chasing a feeling before it fades ("I just wanted to get the feeling down before it goes")?
Should the piece stay open, or does it have to arrive at why it mattered?

angles.title: The city in the morning

uses.quote: The light was nice. There were a lot of dogs out.
My sister says I should write about the city more, but I don't know which part of the city.

open_questions: Which city, and which part of it? The memo doesn't name one.
Are the dogs worth keeping? You called them "silly", but they are one of the two concrete details you noticed.
